item.title: Version 0.1.14
item.description:
RunBar 0.1.14 — official Strava brand assets + simpler Settings.
• Connect with Strava button now uses the official Strava asset (orange, retina-ready). The Powered by Strava attribution in the popover footer is also the official horizontal logo, automatically switching between black and white variants for light/dark mode. • Settings → Sources is now a single Strava card. While the shared RunBar Strava app is queued for quota approval, the Configure flow guides you straight through registering a personal API client. No more two-card confusion. • Drive-by: stale 0.1.2 version strings on the website (JSON-LD, 404 footer) bumped to current.
Privacy unchanged: weekly aggregates only, Strava tokens in Keychain, no telemetry.
